summary: Iteration 3 testing of Deal Inbox (AI Scout, Claude Sonnet 4.6) + Watchlists module. ALL 13 backend pytest tests PASSED (24.5s) including 3 live LLM analyze calls, watchlist matching (Roma WL correctly matched into deal.watchlist_matches), full CRUD on deals + watchlists, status PATCH validation, and url-soft test (example.com returns 200 with prezzo=0, no crash). Frontend Playwright run end-to-end PASSED: sidebar shows Intelligenza section with Deal Inbox + Watchlists; /deal-inbox renders form, analyze button works (text 'Bilocale Navigli 60mq prezzo 245000 ... Milano' produced a card with Deal Score visible in ~10s); detail panel exposes punti_forza + punti_attenzione and 3 action buttons (interessato/trattativa/scartato); clicking 'In trattativa' updates card status to 'In trattativa'; /watchlists CRUD via UI works (UI_TEST_WL created and visible as card); Patrimonio shows the in_trattativa deal as an extra row with 'Deal Inbox' badge and clicking the row correctly redirects to /deal-inbox (not /immobile/...).

minor.issue: When url returns thin/empty content (e.g., https://example.com), the LLM still produces a deal record with prezzo=0/metratura=0/canone_stimato=500 and score 20. Not a bug per spec (Test soft was 'must not crash, return 500 with detail or parse'), but consider returning 422 with a friendlier 'Annuncio non riconoscibile, incolla il testo' message instead of persisting a low-quality deal.

action_items: Optional UX: when /api/deals/analyze gets a URL whose extracted text yields prezzo=0 (LLM couldn't extract), do not persist the deal — return 422 with detail 'Annuncio non riconoscibile, incolla il testo'.
Optional cleanup: the example.com test left behind a low-quality deal record in Patrimonio. Consider auto-purging deals with prezzo==0 OR forcing minimum quality threshold before persistence.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:443 — deal['watchlist_matches'] is computed AFTER score_data merge, which means rendimento_min filter in watchlists works correctly against rendimento_netto. Verified end-to-end via the Roma test.

server.py:493 PATCH /api/watchlists/{wid} expects `attiva` as a query/body bool but is typed as a bare function arg without Pydantic body model — FastAPI will treat it as query param. The frontend currently doesn't call this toggle endpoint so no impact, but flag for future use: should be a body model like WatchlistToggleIn(attiva: bool).
server.py:380 EMERGENT_LLM_KEY check returns 500 — should return 503 (service unavailable) for clearer ops signal.
server.py:298 fetch_url_text timeout=15s is correct per spec; raises HTTPException(400) on non-2xx upstream which propagates correctly.
server.py:333 compute_deal_score formula is deterministic and bounded; rendimento_netto = rendimento_lordo * 0.65 is a reasonable Italian net-of-tax approximation; OK for demo.
DealInbox.jsx + Watchlists.jsx + Patrimonio.jsx all use data-testid consistently; well-structured for testing.
Patrimonio.jsx:118 + 149 — Link uses `p.fromDeal ? '/deal-inbox' : '/immobile/...'` which correctly routes deal rows to the inbox. Verified.
